reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for services and/ or procedures when the place of service is 
appropriately reported. Appropriate reporting includes 
• 
Moderate sedation services conducted by a second physician are only reported with a 
POS code that represents a facility setting 
• 
Services designated as “NA” in the Non- Facility indicator column of the CMS Physician 
fee schedule are not reported as rendered in POS 11 (physician’s office) Effective 11/01/2023 
• 
Services provided on the same date of service as inpatient care where the patient was not 
discharged on the same day or subsequent day are reported using POS 21 (inpatient 
hospital) Effective 11/01/2023 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Moderate sedation services conducted by a second physician are reported with a POS 
code that does not represent a facility setting 
• 
Services designated as “NA” in the Non- Facility indicator column of the CMS Physician 
fee schedule are reported as rendered in POS 11 (physician’s office) Effective 11/01/2023 
• 
Services provided on the same date of service as inpatient care where the patient was not 
discharged on the same day or subsequent day are not reported using POS 21 (inpatient 
hospital) Effective 11/01/2023 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s) and ICD-10-
CM codes reported.
